items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training.

20%  Student career support: Provide individual and group coaching to students on resume and cover letter development, interview preparation, and LinkedIn/professional branding to support internship and job search strategy. Coordinate mock interviews and resume-review workshops. Participate in campus committees to build connections with other campus career advising services and beyond. Collaborate with other departments and programs to coordinate participation in career and recruiting events and to support the distribution of outreach material.

20%  Network building: Develop and maintain an active network of hiring, resource, and funding contacts across corporate, non-profit, and government sectors; match student and alumni profiles to open roles; negotiate and formalize internship, fellowship, and employment pipelines. Organize and participate in recruiting fairs, industry gatherings, donor events, etc. Work proactively to strengthen relationships in a wide variety of industries and organizations to develop relationships and pathways for development engineering, including E4C, EWB, Devex. Organize career and internship events with employers. Identifies, invites, and hosts practitioners to speak on career paths and industry trends; designs panels and fireside-chat formats that connect students directly to working professionals.

20%  Partnerships and Resources:  Researches and develops partnerships with industry, non-profit, government organizations, and individual donors aligned with development engineering, social impact, and entrepreneurship.  Identifies and cultivates opportunities for fellowships, internships, research, and funding to support Center initiatives and broader resource development.

15%  Outreach: Drafts and distributes outreach materials, including brochures, social media, and other collateral as needed to showcase the field of development engineering, the impact of development engineers, and the Blum Center. Uses social media to share career stories of students and alumni to highlight their achievements. Maintains active engagement with the student and alumni community.  Occasional travel to meet program goals, including to events for employers, incoming students, current students, donors, and alumni.

5%    Alumni Relations: Monitors alumni career developments, highlights success stories, and adapts best practices for building and nurturing long-term relationships with Center alumni. Facilitates networking opportunities for students and alumni of MDevEng, Big Ideas, and other Center programs to build a greater, joint network of Blum Center alumni. Establishes outreach channels and programs for serving alumni locally and across the world.

5%    Program integration: Participates in Center leadership efforts to integrate academic programs (e.g., development engineering) and innovation programs (e.g., Big Ideas) to maximize student opportunities and resource sharing.

5%    International Student Support & BIO Liaison: Serves as the department’s primary liaison to the Berkeley International Office (BIO) on internship/work authorization for international students. Stays up to date on regulations and policies (e.g., CPT, OPT, and STEM OPT), helping students navigate resources and requirements during their internship and transition to the job market.
5%    Selects and supervises student associates working in this position.
Advanced knowledge of outreach and advancement methods.
Advanced knowledge of communication and social media best practices.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with everyone and influence, both verbally and in writing.
Advanced knowledge of career development and recruiting.
Advanced knowledge of career development theories, counseling processes, career coaching techniques, decision-making, learning styles, and job search
Ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Knowledge of careers, fellowships, and partnership building across the corporate, nonprofit, and government
